description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Scowtt develops AI/ML marketing optimization and autonomous sales experiences. The Full-Stack Software Engineer will develop, deploy, and maintain software solutions, including full-stack applications, secure integrations, and scalable cloud-based systems.
Full-Stack Software Engineer building Node.js/React applications, REST APIs, and secure AI-agent integrations with OAuth on AWS

Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, and maintain full-stack applications using Node.js, React/Next.js, and TypeScript
• Build and consume REST APIs and implement secure integrations using OAuth and industry-standard authentication practices
• Collaborate with the team to integrate AI agents with external tools like Salesforce, HubSpot, and Twilio
• Contribute to the development of scalable solutions on AWS, utilizing technologies such as Lambda, Amplify, SQS, DynamoDB, and PostgreSQL
• Debug, optimize, and enhance application performance
• Stay up to date with emerging technologies and best practices in software development
• Follow and enforce security best practices, including secure coding, proper handling of sensitive data, authentication/authorization controls, and compliance with company security policies

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, ML, Data Science, or equivalent
• 1-3 years of experience in data structures, algorithms through employment, coursework, projects or internships
• 1-3 years of experience with developing software using technologies like Node.js, React/Next.js, TypeScript through employment, coursework, projects or internships

Preferred:
• Knowledge of REST APIs, OAuth, and integration with external APIs
• Curiosity, ownership mindset, and eagerness to learn
• Exposure to cloud platforms (GCP or AWS)
• Lambda, Amplify, SQS, DynamoDB, PostgreSQL
• Familiarity with tools like BigQuery, notebooks, or basic data pipelines
• Familiarity with the AI Agent development
